operating_notes.text: The company has only one reportable business segment, masterbatches, so no separate segment disclosures are made.
Other income of ₹4.9 Cr in Q1FY27 was 68% of PBT, versus ₹2.07 Cr and 33% in Q1FY26.
FY26 sales volumes of manufactured products rose 0.25% to 15,258 MT with capacity utilisation of 70.81%.
Petrochemical- and pigment-linked feedstock (TiO2, carbon black, synthetic organic pigments) is 55-65% of masterbatch production cost.
Monthly R&D sample development throughput more than doubled over three years from about 300 to about 650 samples/month.

predictions.kpi: Capacity utilisation of expanded Chaksu capacity

timeline.summary: Poddar Pigments reported Q1FY27 standalone revenue of ₹90.13 Cr (-1.2% YoY) and PAT of ₹4.65 Cr (+11.5% YoY)
Poddar Pigments' FY26 annual report shows an unmodified audit with no key audit matters, flat revenue of ₹428.29 Cr, PAT down to ₹14.76 Cr, and ₹849.82 lakh capex adding about 6,000 MT PA at Chaksu.
Poddar Pigments entered into a strategic partnership with Sukano Polymers Corp. USA effective 9th September 2026 for exclusive distribution of its SPD portfolio in the US, Canada and Latin America.
Poddar Pigments Ltd. held its 35th AGM on 2026-09-21 via VC, electing **Gaurav Goenka** (JMD & CEO) as Chairman and approving Rs. 4 dividend per share.
Poddar Pigments Ltd’s 35th AGM on 21.09.2026 approved audited financials, dividend of ₹4/share, and cost auditors’ remuneration via unanimous shareholder votes.
